searchText: Is there a summary for AA breakout #4? https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/future-of-eoa-aa-breakout-room-4/20165 Our (EthereumJS) thoughts on a potential fork timeline: https://notes.ethereum.org/C2xqg0pKRW2TL7WfFqka_Q?view I don't have one, sorry! **ACDE in ~24 minutes** Agenda: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1052 Zoom: https://ethereumfoundation.zoom.us/j/91348592283?pwd=SnRnL1VTeXNYVE9CaWpBbnJEUXhQZz09 Stream: https://youtube.com/live/A5EaPLLRsoQ I have updated this post with the latest stances of clients and stakeholders regarding EOF. Link to the proposed changes to R&D channels PTAL! https://notes.ethereum.org/@danceratopz/testing-channels **ACDE 189 Recap** - After a lot of back and forth, we finalized the Pectra scope 🎉 ! EOF and EIP-7702 are both included (PR: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/8627). To give teams time to work on their EOF implementations and do cross-client testing on everything else in the fork, devnet-1 will **not** include EOF, but will include all other Pectra EIPs. Notably, we'll include 7702 even though the spec may still be changed. - We're tentatively planning to include the following changes in devnet-1, but will leave a few more days for people to review them prior to merging the PRs: - https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/8625 - https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/554 - https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/549 - https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/545 (already merged) - We discussed deactivating EIP-158, as it would cause issues similar to SELFDESTRUCT in a post-Verkle world and EIP-7702 as currently specified could create accounts with 0 nonce/balance/codehash but storage. <@353136597522448385> will draft a proposal to formally consider the change. If 7702 is tweaked in a way that does not cause this issue, we'd consider it for the Verkle fork. - <@364458974906548225> came on to get a status update on EIP-4444 & portal support by client teams. A few client teams have begun working on this, but flagged that they currently have many competing priorities. The Portal team will keep monitoring <#953349957400821860> to offer help to any client team needing it! - We briefly discussed my proposed ACD/Network Upgrade Process/EthMag change doc (https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/allcoredevs-network-upgrade-ethmagicians-process-improvements/20157) and agreed to try the "EIP Review Request" proposal. There weren't any objections to PFI/CFI/SFI, but given the scope I'll open a PR for us to discuss before agreeing to the change. - Testing teams proposed a new channel layout for discord (see above) And, lastly, we flagged the upcoming EPBS (tomorrow) and PeerDAS (June 11) breakouts: - https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1060 - https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1059 some thoughts on peerdas in pectra: https://hackmd.io/@ralexstokes/rJhC_vkSR with two concrete suggestions to (1) uncouple the CL and EL around blob count, and (2) derisk raising the blob count for at-home stakers would love feedback The road to PeerDAS in Pectra - HackMD

excerpts.author: timbeiko
excerpts.content:
**ACDE 189 Recap**
- After a lot of back and forth, we finalized the Pectra scope 🎉 ! EOF and EIP-7702 are both included (PR: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/8627). To give teams time to work on their EOF implementations and do cross-client testing on everything else in the fork, devnet-1 will **not** include EOF, but will include all other Pectra EIPs. Notably, we'll include 7702 even though the spec may still be changed. 
- We're tentatively planning to include the following changes in devnet-1, but will leave a few more days for people to review them prior to merging the PRs: 
    - https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/8625
    - https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/554
    - https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/549
    - https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/545 (already merged)
- We discussed deactivating EIP-158, as it would cause issues similar to SELFDESTRUCT in a post-Verkle world and EIP-7702 as currently specified could create accounts with 0 nonce/balance/codehash but storage. <@353136597522448385> will draft a proposal to formally consider the change. If 7702 is tweaked in a way that does not cause this issue, we'd consider it for the Verkle fork. 
- <@364458974906548225> came on to get a status update on EIP-4444 & portal support by client teams. A few client teams have begun working on this, but flagged that they currently have many competing priorities. The Portal team will keep monitoring <#953349957400821860> to offer help to any client team needing it!
- We briefly discussed my proposed ACD/Network Upgrade Process/EthMag change doc (https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/allcoredevs-network-upgrade-ethmagicians-process-improvements/20157) and agreed to try the "EIP Review Request" proposal. There weren't any objections to PFI/CFI/SFI, but given the scope I'll open a PR for us to discuss before agreeing to the change. 
- Testing teams proposed a new channel layout for discord (see above)

- https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1059
